name: Atmosphere
description: Resource is harvested from a world's atmosphere or atmospheric envelope rather than mined from solid ground.

name: Surface
description: Resource is exposed at the surface or available with collection, quarrying or very shallow excavation.

name: Shallow
description: Resource occurs below the immediate surface but remains accessible to early subsurface excavation, shallow pits, trenches or shallow drilling.

name: Medium
description: Resource requires established mining or drilling infrastructure to reach a significant subsurface deposit.

name: Deep
description: Resource occurs in deep crustal or deeply buried deposits requiring advanced deep-mining or deep-drilling infrastructure.
